messages:
maya: Uploaded a new mock for the batch vectors preview + rerank export. Looking for accessibility and copy nits. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.ai/previews/vec_export_v3.png
liam: Nice — quick thought: export filename should include dataset name + date. e.g., embeddings_export_2024-12-01.csv
olivia: Agree on filename. Also CSV column order? I think: id, source_text, vector_dim, score, rank, metadata
zach: Would prefer score before rank so folks can sort in excel easily. rank can be appended after score
ara: Accessibility: table headers need role=columnheader and aria-sort when sortable. Keyboard nav: allow arrow keys to move between cells and Enter to open row actions
maya: Good call. Also preview row state when vector missing — show a skeleton row and a subtle "Retry" link instead of broken icon
liam: UI: bulk actions should persist selection across pages, or surface a "Select all X results" banner when user selects page
olivia: Copy tweak: change button text from "Export results" -> "Download CSV of ranked vectors" (more explicit for non-product folks)
zach: Colors: contrast on relevance badges looks low (~3:1). We need >=4.5:1 for body text; either darker bg or bolder text weight
maya: Edge case: narrow screens — table collapses to cards. Ensure the inline export button remains visible (sticky) and not below pagination
ara: Screen reader: when export completes announce "Download ready" and move focus to the download link. Also add aria-label for the sample-size dropdown
design-bot: deploy-preview: https://img.redwood.ai/previews/vec_export_v3.png
liam: Small code note for CSV: include metadata JSON as a single string in the metadata column. Example:
```
{"user_id":"123","source":"bulk-upload"}
```
maya: Also rerank UX: show original score + reranked score and a column for "reranker" (cosine / learned reranker) so customers can audit changes
olivia: QA reminder: test with large batches (50k-100k rows) — check pagination perf and export streaming. If too slow ship as background job and email a download link
zach: :thumbsup: on background job approach
ara: A11y nit: current tab order goes ID -> checkbox -> actions. For keyboard users checkbox should be first, then ID, then actions
maya: I'll update the Figma with these changes and post a diff. Can people give quick review by EOD? Want to lock copy + a11y before dev sprint
liam: I'll review after standup
olivia: Me too. Adding a quick checklist here: contrast, aria-sort, keyboard order, export filename, sample-size label, skeleton state, rerank columns
maya: Thanks — will push revised mock and ping again
design-bot: notify: thread marked resolved? false
